role: Manual security workflow: CodeQL SAST over the Swift code and a dependency-review diff between two refs.
state: permissions contents: read (codeql job elevates; dependency-review stays contents: read)
toplevel: Trigger: workflow_dispatch only, inputs base-ref/head-ref. Two independent jobs. No schedule, so neither scan runs unless dispatched.

units.does: macOS-26 job "CodeQL (Swift)" (timeout 60, security-events: write): checkout, Xcode 26.6, CodeQL init (security-and-quality), explicit Debug simulator build, analyze.
github/codeql-action/init (SHA-pinned v3.37.9) for language swift with query suite security-and-quality.

`xcodebuild build -onlyUsePackageVersionsFromResolvedFile` (packages held to the committed Package.resolved) Emuqu scheme, generic iOS Simulator, Debug, CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO, SWIFT_TREAT_WARNINGS_AS_ERRORS=NO so CodeQL's extractor observes the compile.
github/codeql-action/analyze, category /language:swift; uploads SARIF to code scanning.

ubuntu job "Dependency review" (timeout 15, permissions contents: read only): full-history checkout, a guard that fails unless base and head resolve to different commits, then dependency-review-action between the two refs.
actions/checkout with fetch-depth 0, so the next step can resolve both refs.

Resolves BASE_REF (inputs.base-ref or the default branch) and HEAD_REF (inputs.head-ref or github.sha) to commits, trying the ref as given and then origin/<ref>. Fails if either does not resolve, or if both are the same commit (the review would compare nothing and report success), telling the user to dispatch with base-ref set to an earlier tag or SHA; otherwise prints the two commits.
units.entry: Step of security.yml dependency-review job (workflow_dispatch only); a failing step fails the job and skips the review.

branches.cond: ref does not resolve as given
branches.effect: resolve() tries origin/<ref>; fails if that does not resolve either

branches.cond: base and head are the same commit

units.key: step dependency-review/Require the Swift packages in the dependency graph
units.does: Fetches the repository's dependency-graph SBOM with `gh api repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/dependency-graph/sbom` (GH_TOKEN = github.token) and, for every pin in the Xcode project's Package.resolved (location with scheme and .git stripped, read by an inline python3), requires a `pkg:swift/<location>@` or `pkg:swift/<location>"` entry (case-insensitive); any missing package is listed and the step exits 1, so the review cannot report success for Swift packages it does not compare.
units.entry: GitHub Actions step in security.yml's dependency-review job (workflow_dispatch), after 'Refuse an empty comparison'; a failure skips the review.

branches.cond: a pinned package's purl is not in the SBOM

branches.effect: print the list and exit 1; else print success

units.does: actions/dependency-review-action v5.0.0 (SHA-pinned) comparing base-ref (input or default branch) to head-ref (input or github.sha), the same two refs the previous step proved distinct; fails on high/critical advisories or GPL-2.0/GPL-3.0/AGPL-3.0/LGPL-3.0 licences. Posts no PR comment (none exists on dispatch).
